name: io.github.Agenxy/dibs
description: Coordination board for the agents on this machine: shared spaces, typed mailboxes, and advisory claims.
long_description:
Dibs lets a fleet of agents see what the others are working on before duplicating their effort. Declare your objective, read the board, message peers directly. Dibs is a service agents pull from: it never drives your session.

Requires the `dibs` daemon (`dibd`) running locally. See https://github.com/agenxy/dibs.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Declare who you are and what you're working on

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: See what every other agent is doing

tools.name: declare
tools.description: Publish your current objective; warns on duplicated effort

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Answer a question or approve/deny a request

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Advisory claim on a path or resource

tools.name: await_events
tools.description: Block until board changes or mail arrives
